changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant dataset abbreviations that were duplicates of full names. Removed 'Other:Event-relational reasoning' as it's too generic - kept specific task types. Added more detailed output descriptions based on paper content.
Normalized all F1 variants to 'F1' as they represent the same metric family. Added missing metrics (Accuracy, HIT@1) that were explicitly mentioned in the paper.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper uses T5 and BART for generation, but not for evaluation.
No human evaluation was mentioned in the paper. All evaluation was conducted using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on event-relational reasoning using a unified text-to-text generation framework. It evaluates generated outputs primarily using automatic metrics (F1, EM, Accuracy, HIT@1) across multiple NLG tasks including QA, Relation Extraction, NLI, and Multiple Choice. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric names and removal of duplicate dataset entries.
